overview:
Grace Meng seeks another term in this Queens-area district, which leans Democratic by about six points. She enters the general election with roughly two million dollars raised and one million on hand, while Republican Joseph Chou has reported only a few thousand dollars in fundraising and minimal cash reserves. No outside groups are spending in the race, and no general-election polls or expert ratings are available. Prediction markets price her win probability at about 97 percent.

The combination of incumbency, a lopsided financial advantage, and the district's Democratic lean points to a comfortable Meng victory. The main uncertainty is the absence of polling, which makes the exact size of her margin harder to pin down than the likely outcome itself. Fundamentals of this kind typically produce margins in the high teens to low twenties for the incumbent party.
